verdict.rationale: Cooley GO is a web-based document generator and resource site, so a public, versioned API is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no API, no versioning and no deprecation policy, and probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs and llms.txt all returned 404. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields "none".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
